name: pit-shark-belt-squat
instructions:
1. Setup in a standing position on the pit shark with the chain belt around your waist.
2. Attach the hook from the belt to the pit shark and stand tall.
3. While holding onto the machine's handles, initiate the squat by flexing at the knees and hips simultaneously.
4. Descend to nearly parallel (or just below) then drive through the whole foot and focus on pushing the floor away.
5. Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
